integrity: The uniform proof is independent of the finite checker. The checker exhaustively validates the stated elementary-collapse sequence for 1501 connected labeled bipartite square-free graphs on at most six vertices; enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The collapse theorem assumes a finite connected simple bipartite graph with no 4-cycle. The homotopy consequence alone is covered by broader later square-free Hom-complex theory; the asserted new content is the explicit simplicial collapse onto a forest-contraction graph spine.
title: Explicit graph spines for neighborhood complexes of square-free bipartite graphs
